# Zykken

> Zykken is an AI automation agency and business-systems studio in India. We build business automation, WhatsApp chatbots and AI voice agents (Hindi and English), CRM with lead follow-up, website design and development, and custom software for growing businesses. All work is custom-quoted, and every project starts with a free 30-minute audit. Contact: info@zykken.com

## Services
- [Website Design & Development](https://www.zykken.com/services/intentpath): Website design and development in India: copy, design, build and measurement in one project, with a guided enquiry journey to the right person.
- [WhatsApp & Voice AI Agents](https://www.zykken.com/services/carryline): WhatsApp chatbots and AI voice agents in Hindi and English for Indian businesses: answer enquiries, qualify leads, book calls and hand off to your team.
- [CRM & Lead Follow-up](https://www.zykken.com/services/pledgedesk): A custom CRM that tracks leads and the commitments inside conversations, built for real estate and sales teams in India.
- [Business Automation](https://www.zykken.com/services/flowback): AI workflow automation for lead routing, onboarding, documents and reporting, built around your existing tools.
- [Custom Software & Portals](https://www.zykken.com/services/previewops): Custom portals, dashboards, member apps and internal tools, with a preview step to review a change before it goes live.

## Results (case studies)
- [Luxe Estates, real estate, Mumbai](https://www.zykken.com/case-study/luxe-estates): a WhatsApp and voice lead qualifier with CRM routing cut lead follow-up from 6 hours to 38 seconds.
- [Velvet & Co, e-commerce, Delhi](https://www.zykken.com/case-study/velvet-co): storefront rebuilt in 18 days, with 1.1s LCP on 4G mobile and conversion up from 0.9% to 3.1%.
- [Pulse Fit OS, fitness](https://www.zykken.com/case-study/pulse-fit-os): member app, trainer dashboard and AI plan generator built in 19 days, saving 1,100 admin hours a year.
- [Noir Clinic, healthcare, Pune](https://www.zykken.com/case-study/noir-clinic): a Hindi and English AI voice receptionist with WhatsApp reminders answers the line 24/7, with zero missed calls in 4 months.
- [Kinetic Logistics, logistics](https://www.zykken.com/case-study/kinetic-logistics): document AI reads PODs and invoices and syncs them to sheet and CRM, saving the ops team 31 hours a week.
- [Hearth & Home, home services](https://www.zykken.com/case-study/hearth-home): CRM and website with quotes in under 60 seconds and 60-day auto follow-up, giving 2.6x enquiries with no new hires.

- [Which business process should you automate first?](https://www.zykken.com/blog/automate-your-highest-impact-workflow): find the repeated task that costs the most time, errors or sales, then build one clear first win.
- [How to connect website leads to your CRM and book more calls](https://www.zykken.com/blog/from-first-enquiry-to-booked-call): connect website and ad enquiries to a CRM, qualify and follow up fast.
- [After your AI system launches: handover, monitoring and support](https://www.zykken.com/blog/what-happens-after-your-ai-system-launches): why monitoring, clear handover and a scoped support plan keep a system useful.
